userStories.title: Add recap-line and destiny-sentence expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the trilogy to leave me with a sentence I can naturally use to summarize what kind of merchant I became.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least three recap-line or destiny-sentence readable signals across the existing expression surfaces
Make all three routes support a distinct and replayable player-summary sentence
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests
userStories.notes: Added deriveSampleLineDestinySentence() function, reframed payoff success metaphors, strengthened age-40 identity with success-shape emphasis. 3+ groups of readable signals: payoff success shape, destiny sentence, age-40 identity shape.

userStories.title: Wire success-shape differentiation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the three success shapes expressed through bounded runtime-visible carriers so the recap difference is not just prose detached from the route.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the differentiation only through existing carriers, markers, or expression-adjacent wiring
Do not introduce a new merchant or ending framework
Existing P58, P59, P61, P63, P64, and P66 evidence does not regress
Keep success-shape and recap signals aligned with each other
userStories.notes: All differentiation implemented via existing expression framework in sampleLineExpression.ts — no new systems, no new frameworks. P58/P59/P61/P63/P64/P66 tests all still pass.
